new_behavior: stable(copies, expected_tuple) first rechecks immutable inputs, then directly reads all four live canonical paths through existing no-reparse guard.
Live raw bytes must equal the already hash-verified ordered immutable copies; parsed CP/OW/failure length/head must equal explicit expected tuple/e2.
The original four stable call sites are retained: before leaf allocation, after pending writes, after inputs write, and after manifest write before success.
Mutable live files never enter READS or immutable inputs.json. Observations are separate point-in-time hash/length/equality/tuple/head facts.
Root captures final stdout live observations or original stderr pre-leaf failure observations; after allocation own failure.json also preserves observations and original primary traceback.
unchanged: r333 independent closure and four immutable copied-digest bindings
limits: Point-in-time checks do not lock canonical or prove lifecycle immutability.
All candidate and gate execution remains NOT_RUN.
Before-leaf exceptions write only original stderr; no Root leaf is allocated.
A failure after leaf creation preserves it; no automatic retry/reset or rollback.
